admin_enabled.description: Whether the admin user is enabled.
admin_enabled.title: Admin enabled

anonymous_pull_enabled.description: Whether anonymous pulls are enabled (Standard/Premium only).
anonymous_pull_enabled.title: Anonymous pull enabled

data_endpoint_enabled.description: Whether dedicated data endpoints are enabled (Premium only).
data_endpoint_enabled.title: Data endpoint enabled

export_policy_enabled.description: Whether the export policy is enabled (Premium only).
export_policy_enabled.title: Export policy enabled

identity_ids.description: List of User Assigned Identity IDs. Required when identity_type includes UserAssigned.
identity_ids.title: Identity ids

identity_type.description: Managed identity type. One of: SystemAssigned, UserAssigned, SystemAssigned\, UserAssigned.
identity_type.title: Identity type

name.description: Name of the Container Registry (alphanumeric only).
name.title: Name

network_rule_bypass_option.description: Whether trusted Azure services can bypass network rules. One of: None, AzureServices.
network_rule_bypass_option.title: Network rule bypass option

public_network_access_enabled.description: Whether public network access is allowed.
public_network_access_enabled.title: Public network access enabled

quarantine_policy_enabled.description: Whether the quarantine policy is enabled (Premium only).
quarantine_policy_enabled.title: Quarantine policy enabled

resource_group_name.description: Name of the Resource Group to create the Container Registry in.
resource_group_name.title: Resource group name

retention_policy_in_days.description: Days to retain untagged manifests (Premium only).
retention_policy_in_days.title: Retention policy in days

sku.description: SKU tier of the Container Registry. One of: Basic, Standard, Premium.
sku.title: Sku

tags.description: Tags to apply to the Container Registry.
tags.title: Tags

trust_policy_enabled.description: Whether content trust is enabled (Premium only).
trust_policy_enabled.title: Trust policy enabled

zone_redundancy_enabled.description: Whether zone redundancy is enabled (Premium only).
zone_redundancy_enabled.title: Zone redundancy enabled
